title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale at Colonade Residence!
description_en: We offer a 2+1 apartment for sale in one of the most ambitious projects on Dritan Hoxha street. Construction by Nova Construction Group, Colonade Residence. The apartment is located on the third residential floor, completely facing west, on the second street. It is organized in a living room with a kitchen area, two bedrooms, a toilet and a loggia balcony. For more information, do not hesitate to contact me.
